mapper.insert: insert into a2a_results(tenant_id,a2a_result_id,a2a_request_id,root_task_id,parent_task_id,child_task_id,result_status,result_summary,result_payload_ref,evidence_refs_json,completed_by_agent_id,assignment_id,execution_attempt_id,attempt_no,dispatch_request_id,dispatch_token_hash,fencing_token_hash,agent_session_id,callback_inbox_id,payload_hash,result_schema_version,result_evidence_hash,result_fingerprint,policy_version,policy_snapshot_hash,acceptance_attempt_id,received_at,accepted_at,completed_at,idempotency_key,created_at,version) values(#{result.tenantId},#{result.resultId},#{result.requestId},#{result.rootTaskId},#{result.parentTaskId},#{result.childTaskId},#{result.resultStatus},#{result.resultSummary},#{result.resultPayloadRef},cast(#{result.evidenceRefsJson} as jsonb),#{result.completedByAgentId},#{result.assignmentId},#{result.executionAttemptId},#{result.attemptNo},#{result.dispatchRequestId},#{result.dispatchTokenHash},#{result.fencingTokenHash},#{result.agentSessionId},#{result.callbackInboxId},#{result.payloadHash},#{result.resultSchemaVersion},#{result.resultEvidenceHash},#{result.resultFingerprint},#{result.policyVersion},#{result.policySnapshotHash},#{result.acceptanceAttemptId},#{result.receivedAt},#{result.acceptedAt},#{result.completedAt},#{result.idempotencyKey},coalesce(#{result.createdAt},now()),#{result.version}) on conflict(tenant_id,a2a_request_id) do nothing
mapper.select: select * from a2a_results where tenant_id=#{tenantId} and a2a_result_id=#{resultId}
select * from a2a_results where tenant_id=#{tenantId} and a2a_request_id=#{requestId}
select * from a2a_results where tenant_id=#{tenantId} and idempotency_key=#{idempotencyKey}
select * from a2a_results where tenant_id=#{tenantId} and parent_task_id=#{parentTaskId} order by completed_at desc limit #{limit}
